name: Barbell Bulgarian Split Squat
steps: Set the bar across your upper back and rest the top of one foot on a bench behind you.
Bend your front knee and hip to lower your back knee toward the floor.
Push through the front foot to stand back up.
Switch sides after finishing this side.
tips: Keep your front heel planted flat and your knee tracking straight over your toes.
Keep your torso mostly upright rather than leaning heavily back onto the rear bench.
